description.name: JOVEpay Crypto Payments
description.tagline: Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, and other cryptocurrencies on WHMCS invoices.
description.long: JOVEpay is a third-party cryptocurrency payment gateway for WHMCS. Customers pay invoices on the JOVEpay hosted payment widget. WHMCS receives HMAC-signed Instant Payment Notifications and records invoice payments automatically. A JOVEpay merchant account is required.
features: Accept crypto payments on WHMCS invoices
Hosted checkout with light and dark themes
